concerns.text: The URL provided for the TinyLlama‑300M checkpoint (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/open-llm-leaderboard-old/details_PY007__TinyLlama-1.1B-step-50K-105b/resolve/main/2023-09-12T12-30-04.204611/details_harness|arc:challenge|25_2023-09-12T12-30-04.204611.parquet`) points to a dataset artifact rather than a model checkpoint. This constitutes a wrong‑dataset citation for the model weights, which would prevent loading the intended TinyLlama model and invalidate the experiment.

The plan states that all steps will run on CPU‑only GitHub Actions runners using a ~300 M‑parameter TinyLlama model in FP16. PyTorch’s CPU backend does not support native FP16 arithmetic; attempting mixed‑precision FP16 on CPU will raise runtime errors or silently degrade performance, making the compute budget infeasible under the free‑tier constraints.
